g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
text.tspan: Average time spent on different activities in a 24-hour day by

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
text.tspan: people aged 15 to 64, according to each country's most recent

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
text.tspan: time-use survey in the OECD database over the period

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Data source: OECD Time Use Database (2026)

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585

g.text: Averages cover everyone aged 15 to 64, on weekdays and weekends alike. They include

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: days and people with no paid work or study. Unpaid work also includes religious and civic

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: activities, and time the OECD doesn't assign to another category, including some travel.
